submarket: HIDDEN MARKET — "Feeding the mother while she's feeding the baby"

finding.headline: "The Forgetter"
finding.problem: "I look at the clock and it's 4pm and I haven't eaten since yesterday's dinner. I'm not even hungry — I just forgot I'm a person."
finding.recurring_situation: HIDDEN MARKET — "Feeding the mother while she's feeding the baby"
finding.person: A 28-yr-old first-time mum, 4 weeks PP, mild postpartum anxiety, who literally forgets to eat for 10+ hours; when she notices, she's shaking and weepy.
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.

disposition.rationale: Report assigns: "Standalone — "Don't Forget to Eat, Mama: A 40-Day 'Eat-When-Baby-Eats' System."". Verdict: PASSES (21/25)..
